subject: Future Tech
title: The Overview Effect
description: A fast breakdown of The Overview Effect for builders.

hook.text: Astronauts who see Earth from space report a profound cognitive shift. They call it the overview effect.

buildup.text: Borders vanish. The atmosphere looks paper thin. Astronauts describe an overwhelming urge to protect the pale blue dot.

discovery.text: Frank White coined the term in 1987 after interviewing dozens of astronauts about their emotional transformation.

twist.text: Some argue colonists who grow up off-world may never feel this connection to Earth, creating a new cultural divide.

climax.text: The overview effect fuels the space movement. Protecting Earth and expanding beyond it are the same motivation.

punchline.text: Leaving home is how we learn to love it.
